_comment: Sunken house: a flooded brick house on the floor of the Astra Ocean, with 2 loot chests.
The building itself is structures/sunken_house.nbt (open/edit it in-game with a Structure Block: name 'per_aspera_ad_astra:sunken_house').
Where it spawns: biomes in tags/worldgen/biome/has_sunken_house.json. How often: worldgen/structure_set/sunken_house.json.
